name: Desktop Support
query:
SELECT
    U.full_name AS FullName,
    I.case_owner,
    SUM(CASE WHEN I.status = 'Closed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Closed_Case
FROM
    `tabIssue` AS I
JOIN
    `tabUser` AS U ON I.case_owner = U.email
WHERE
    I.issue_type = 'Desktop Support'
    AND I.status = 'Closed'
    AND YEAR(I.modified) = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE)
    AND MONTH(I.modified) = MONTH(CURDATE())
GROUP BY
    I.case_owner, U.full_name;
